_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored, per-machine) and set inputDeviceName/outputDeviceName + any tuning. The MAC/IP/COM/host below are this rig's real values - adjust if yours differ.
_steamMachineName: OPTIONAL: the gaming PC's Steam client name (its Windows hostname). Pins install-by-voice/download-status to this box when another PC is also signed in. Empty = first signed-in client.
_tvIp: The set's LAN address - give it a DHCP reservation, because the /api/v2/ power-state read (cglib.tv_power_state) fails silently if this drifts. OPTIONAL; without it two things stay off: duckSteps (gated on the TV reporting itself on) and the launch path's TV evidence in couch.py, which falls back to a blind power_on.

voice._wakeTuning: All five OPTIONAL (audio.py/voice_agent.py read them with defaults) and deliberately not in REQUIRED_VOICE - config.json is gitignored, so a key mandatory in code is an agent that will not start after a git pull. wakeNearMissFactor (fraction of wakeThreshold): emit wake_near_miss for a run of scores that got this close and never crossed - the only trace recall leaves. Raise toward 1.0 if a loud room makes it chatty. wakeClipsKeep: fired pre-rolls kept under logs/wake as wavs, the corpus a custom verifier trains negatives on; 0 disables, 200 is ~13 MB.
voice._wakeGates: wakeVadThreshold (0-1, Silero speech gate) and wakePatience (N consecutive frames above threshold, costing (N-1)*80ms, capped at 30 by openWakeWord's prediction buffer) are RECOMMENDED AT 0: both suppress detections, and the 2026-08-15 failure was already too FEW. Turn them on when wake_near_miss shows real margin - VAD first (0.3-0.5), which kills effects and music but not TV dialogue, which is speech and passes cleanly.
voice._wakeVerifier: openWakeWord's second stage, off unless named. A filename in k15/voice/models (bench/train_verifier.py writes it), fitted on clips this rig fired on - no threshold separates them (2026-08-15: false accepts at 0.25/0.26/0.28 against a median genuine wake of 0.255). It REPLACES the score rather than gating it, so turning it on voids every wakeThreshold measured without it and --wake-trials must be re-run. Speaker-specific: train it on everyone who uses the room. wakeVerifierThreshold is the score above which it engages, not the wake threshold.
voice._duckSteps: SOUNDBAR volume points dropped for the length of a session and restored on close (TvDucker). 0 = off; needs tvIp plus the one-time WS pairing (.venv\Scripts\python tv_remote.py pair). Fires only when the set reports itself ON (2026-08-16: blind bursts at a standby set) and moves volume via remote-key relay verified against the TV's readback - NOT Ex-Link or UPnP SetVolume, which eARC audio refuses with an ack and an on-screen 'Not Available' (2026-08-21). Helps the STT, not the wake word (nothing ducks until wake fires); a couch talker reaches the mic 10-20 dB below TV dialogue. 10 is a starting point, not a measurement.
voice._duckToPct: Alternative depth knob, wins over duckSteps when both are set. 0 = off; 1-99 = duck TO this percent of the pre-duck level (50 halves it, 25 is a deep duck), so the drop scales with the current volume instead of being a flat count.
voice._eagerEot: DORMANT on pipecat 1.7: Flux sends EagerEndOfTurn but it arrives as an interim frame nothing downstream screens, so these two buy no latency today. Left on for a pipecat that implements the cancellable path; see session_runtime before changing them.
voice._navTargets: Spoken form -> nav kind. List every determiner you'd say: the {target} slot is an exact list, so a missing form does not fall back, it falls THROUGH to the wildcards below Nav in grammar.yaml.
